findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_feature_catalog · Private data: sandbox_backtest, submit_strategy, list_strategies, get_strategy_report, open_source_strategy, fork_strategy, delist_strategy · Public sink: submit_strategy, delist_strategy · Destructive: sandbox_backtest, get_strategy_report, get_tournament_status, delist_strategy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_feature_catalog · Private data: sandbox_backtest, submit_strategy, list_strategies, get_strategy_report, open_source_strategy, fork_strategy, delist_strategy · Public sink: submit_strategy, delist_strategy · Destructive: sandbox_backtest, get_strategy_report, get_tournament_status, delist_strategy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
